quote: Our MBR process produces great quality water for Title 22 reuse. Good screening at the head of the plant is important to keep material from fouling the membranes. Properly maintaining the blowers and the aeration system is the other big piece of it, because good air scour is critical. Nobody wants to replace membranes early–they are expensive! In general, there are more instruments that need to be calibrated and maintained, and operators will need to learn some new things. But once you learn the process, the system is easy to run.
